calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-session relative strength versus the cross-sectional median, amplified or attenuated by lagged recent cross-asset return dispersion relative to its 120-session median. All inputs are lagged or available at the decision cutoff.
calculation.lookahead_control: The dispersion multiplier is shifted one session and the relative-strength signal is shifted one session; validation uses prices through 2026-07-15 only and forward returns start after the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 20d IC was positive in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025 and 2026; negative in 2024. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation despite broad date coverage.
